body:
## Summary

This PR migrates the [`algolia/instantsearch-specs`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-specs) project to the InstantSearch monorepo.

## Notable changes

- The package is renamed `instantsearch.css` to match the npm package
- The `specs`site is moved to `website` (see [preview](https://deploy-preview-5179--instantsearchjs.netlify.app/specs/))
- The README is rewritten to follow the same style as the `instantsearch.js` one
- Commits are rewritten to reference pull requests from [`algolia/instantsearch-specs`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-specs)

## Next steps

- Install and set up [Stylelint](https://stylelint.io/) to enforce quality rules and facilitate contributions from feature teams (in another PR to avoid cluttering this one with linting updates)
- Ensure that we're able to properly infer next versions _per package_ (e.g., `instantsearch-specs` recently got a [breaking change](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-specs/pull/125) but wasn't released yet)
- Decide how to consolidate all different sites (stories, examples, specs, etc., likely once all packages are migrated)
- Harmonize and/or consolidate READMEs, `.gitignore`, `.npmignore`, etc. (likely once all packages are migrated)

FX-2049
